comparator.name: Psychology
comparator.sourceNotes: Open Universiteit offers a 60 EC foundation, 60 EC of later compulsory courses, 25 EC of restricted minor-course electives, 20 EC of free electives and a 15 EC thesis.
components: Introduction to Work and Organizational Psychology
Psychological Diagnostics: Theory, Models and Methods
The university offers six minors. Students can combine a 15 EC minor with 10 EC from other minor courses.
Choose eligible courses to deepen or broaden your studies.

courses: New Issues in Contemporary Social Theory

core: Human behaviour, motivation, development, personality and social influence
Psychological problems, health, stress, diagnosis and intervention
Biological and cognitive foundations of brain and behaviour
adjacent: Heredity, neuropsychology, cognition and personality differences
Quantitative, qualitative and evidence-based psychological research
questions: How do biological, cognitive, social and developmental processes shape behaviour?
How are psychological problems assessed, explained and treated?
How can psychological claims and interventions be tested with sound evidence?

alternatives.label: Psychology, Behavior and Research
alternatives.labelReason: Study how people think, develop and behave in social settings, at work and in health. Combine cognitive, social and organizational psychology with quantitative and qualitative research.
alternatives.concept: Study how people think, develop and behave in social settings, at work and in health. Combine cognitive, social and organizational psychology with quantitative and qualitative research.
progression: Brain and behavior precedes advanced cognition, psychopathology and assessment. Research foundations precede organizational psychology and advanced evidence synthesis.

alternatives.label: Clinical, Health and Lifespan Psychology
alternatives.labelReason: Study psychological development, mental disorders, health behavior and approaches to assessment and therapy. Use research methods, epidemiology and pharmacology to examine evidence about health and interventions.
alternatives.concept: Study psychological development, mental disorders, health behavior and approaches to assessment and therapy. Use research methods, epidemiology and pharmacology to examine evidence about health and interventions.
progression: Behavioral foundations precede psychopathology, health and lifespan psychology. Psychopathology precedes diagnostics and therapies. Research methods support later empirical study.
alternatives.distinctness: Study psychological development, mental disorders, health behavior and approaches to assessment and therapy. Use research methods, epidemiology and pharmacology to examine evidence about health and interventions. Each plan has 4 courses absent from the other when compared with option 1.

alternatives.label: Brain, Cognition and Behavioral Science
alternatives.labelReason: Study how the brain supports perception, action, language and memory. Use biology, laboratory work, programming and behavioral data analysis to investigate how these processes relate to behavior.
alternatives.concept: Study how the brain supports perception, action, language and memory. Use biology, laboratory work, programming and behavioral data analysis to investigate how these processes relate to behavior.
progression: Biology and brain foundations precede cell biology and advanced cognition. Perception and action precedes higher cognitive functions. Programming and data preparation support later machine learning.
alternatives.distinctness: Study how the brain supports perception, action, language and memory. Use biology, laboratory work, programming and behavioral data analysis to investigate how these processes relate to behavior. Each plan has 9 courses absent from the other when compared with option 1. Each plan has 7 courses absent from the other when compared with option 2.

blocks: Both introduce psychology through biological, cognitive and behavioural perspectives; OU provides a broader 10-EC disciplinary survey.
Both cover theories and evidence about social influence, cognition and interpersonal behaviour.
Open Universiteit teaches personality and theoretical approaches in a dedicated clinical course.
Open Universiteit teaches structured conversational practice. UCR develops communication through rhetoric and persuasion.
UCR integrates historical context in individual courses but lacks a selected dedicated history-of-psychology module.
Both study workplace behavior, motivation and teams. UCR also covers leadership.
Both introduce research design, measurement, experiments and statistics.
Both provide qualitative research design, interviewing and interpretation.
Both develop experimental methods and statistical analysis for behavioural research.
Both analyze empirical data. Open Universiteit applies this specifically to cross-sectional psychological research.
Open Universiteit studies psychological measurement and decisions in a dedicated course. UCR develops general quantitative methods.
Both develop critical synthesis of psychological research. UCR includes evidence appraisal and meta-analysis.
UCR teaches scientific reasoning across its research courses but lacks a separate selected introduction-to-science module.
UCR includes research design and statistics but lacks a selected dedicated longitudinal-research practicum.
Open Universiteit requires a 15 EC thesis after 120 EC, including all research practicums and the literature study. UCR offers optional independent research outside the scheduled degree.
Both apply psychological theory and evidence to health, stress and illness.
Both examine mental disorders and psychopathology.
Both examine psychological development across the lifespan.
Both examine psychological assessment and diagnosis; UCR also covers psychotherapies.
UCR includes communication and psychological study but lacks a selected dedicated psychological-interviewing practicum.
UCR covers health and social behaviour but lacks a selected dedicated work-and-health psychology module.
Open Universiteit applies evolution to psychological questions in a dedicated course. UCR develops related biological foundations.
Both study neural mechanisms of behavior. Open Universiteit also teaches psychopharmacology in this course.
Both examine the biological and cognitive bases of higher mental functions.

notes.text: Both universities offer behavioral, social, cognitive, developmental and health psychology with research methods. Open Universiteit also requires dedicated psychological interviewing, psychometrics and longitudinal research courses and a 15 EC thesis.

selection.assessment: The broad plan integrates social, cognitive, organizational and health psychology with research. The clinical and lifespan plan emphasizes disorders, interventions and health evidence. The brain and cognition plan emphasizes biological mechanisms, laboratory methods and behavioral data. Dedicated psychometrics, psychological interviewing and longitudinal research remain gaps.

audience.programmeDescription: This Dutch-taught, part-time degree studies human behavior, cognition, development and mental health through psychological theory and research.
audience.comparisonExplanation: Open Universiteit combines compulsory psychology and research courses with minor-course electives and a thesis. The three UCR options emphasize broad psychology, clinical and health questions, or brain and cognition.
